india.one_line: Indian AI developments span venture funding, new hardware launches, judicial review on authorship, and product testing.

themes.title: AI startup M raises $9 million
themes.text: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M secured $9 million in a funding round led by RTP Global, bringing its total capital raised to about $20 million.

stories.headline: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas' AI startup M raises $9 Mn

themes.title: HP launches AI laptop in India
themes.text: HP launched its OmniBook Ultra 16 AI laptop in India, priced at ₹5,49,999 to target developers and creative professionals.

stories.headline: HP launches OmniBook Ultra 16 AI laptop in India at ₹5,49,999

themes.title: Delhi High Court examines AI copyright
themes.text: The Delhi High Court issued notice on an appeal concerning whether an AI system can be recognized as an author under the Copyright Act, 1957.

stories.headline: Delhi High Court to examine if AI can be author under copyright law

themes.title: Jio Platforms pulls AI astrology platform
themes.text: Jio Platforms took its newly launched AI astrology platform offline after a few hours, describing the release as a closed demo survey.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms launches and takes down AI astrology platform JioAstro
